Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 11, 2022

On Jul 5, 2022, SME digital sales SaaS Xiaoshoubao (销售保) (founded 2019) received an equity round from Fanchuang Capital (2nd round). Stack: telecom SaaS, sales CRM, WeChat lead marketing, private-community platform — outbound dialer (2–4× productivity), risk number scrubbing, CRM funnel + call QA, WeChat marketing. Free system + low telecom fees for SMEs. Controller Gao Hui 38.5%.

— END —
